question: Name the tiny pores present on leaves of plants.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Stomata.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** pores **present on the leaves of plants is **stomota.**
 
• **Stomata** are mostly found in **green aerial parts of plants,** such as stem and particularly on the leaves.
